verdict.rationale: Yapily is fundamentally an API/webhook platform (HTTP Basic Auth with app ID/secret, REST endpoints, OpenAPI spec, generated client libraries, webhook notifications) which is inherently scriptable and automatable without a UI, supporting headless/CI-style usage of the Data and Payments APIs.  Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or documentation, a dedicated CLI tool, and independent confirmation of automated/headless test-suite integration.
